name: External mouse-social pretraining to held-SOE transfer
scientific_question: Does broad mouse-social pretraining produce reusable relational dynamics that improve a biologically grounded social world model in completely held-out SOE animals, beyond identical architecture trained from scratch?

optional_neural_auxiliary: VTA dopamine social interaction/social prediction error

models: Relational SWM v2 pretrained on external mouse-social data
identical Relational SWM v2 random/scratch initialization
data_budgets: 100% of target-animal training context where allowed
primary_metrics: held-animal log loss / bits per event
AUC for prospective efficacy and Observe
sample efficiency area under target-data curve
world_model_metrics: cross-agent future prediction where source data permit
specificity_controls: lab/context adversarial readout to measure domain leakage

promotion_gate.pretrained_vs_scratch: positive paired effect in >=22/27 held animals and one-sided paired P<0.01 at full target data; positive median advantage at >=3 target-data budgets
promotion_gate.sample_efficiency: pretrained model reaches scratch full-data performance using <=50% target data OR shows significant paired gain at <=25%
promotion_gate.social_specificity: pretraining advantage must materially decrease under wrong-social/no-social/pair-shuffle controls
promotion_gate.future_dynamics: pretrained model must beat scratch on multistep future-event NLL, not only current-action classification
promotion_gate.no_shortcut: identity/lab metadata removal must not eliminate the main transfer advantage
promotion_gate.project_relevance: At least one prespecified SOE primary endpoint must improve versus identical scratch, and the aggregate SOE endpoint family must not degrade. Otherwise the external pretraining branch is rejected regardless of its CalMS/MABe score.
promotion_gate.mechanistic_preservation: Pretraining must preserve or improve current SLM/SWM biological interpretation: social content, efficacy/credit, multiscale memory and intervention logic.
promotion_gate.negative_transfer_guard: Neural auxiliary pretraining must not worsen held-SOE behavioral prediction; neural->behavior fusion stays closed unless held-animal SOE evidence opens it.

secondary_neural_gate.goal: Does the same latent align with independent social neural datasets?
tests: VTA social value / social prediction-error timing
secondary_neural_gate.claim_boundary: neural alignment is convergent biological validation unless held-animal causal perturbation is available

claim_if_pass: Broad mouse-social pretraining yields reusable relational world-state dynamics that lower the data required to model a new animal and preserve social-content specificity.
claim_if_fail: External action/pose pretraining does not transfer enough biologically relevant social state into SOE; revise objective/ontology rather than scaling architecture.
project_priority: External datasets/models are subordinate to the user's SOE/SLM/SWM. No external benchmark result is a promotion criterion by itself.
soe_primary_endpoints: held-animal prospective social efficacy / Active-vs-Unrewarded ranking
held-animal Observe policy and Observe->Active conversion
observed demonstrator-feeding content -> native Feed conversion
VTA/OXT/JAWS mechanistic and causal consistency without leaking neural state into behavior by default
